stem.en: Which statement about mammals is correct?

text.en: The zygote develops inside the female body

feedback.en: Yes. The young one grows inside the mother and is born later.

text.en: The young hatch from eggs left in open water

feedback.en: That fits fish and frogs, not mammals in general.

text.en: The young find all their own food from birth

feedback.en: Mammals typically feed their young on breast milk for some time.

text.en: The young hatch as larvae that feed on waste

feedback.en: Larvae are found in insects and frogs, not in mammals.

explanation.en: In mammals, the zygote grows and develops inside the female body. Mammals typically feed their young on breast milk for some time after birth.
